judge_reason: The return_delivered_order_items call used item_ids=["4579334072","6117189161"] for order #W5490111. The task was to return everything not associated with gaming except the keyboard and mouse, and prior order details showed a Backpack with item_id "4947717507" in the same order; omitting it made the item_ids parameter incomplete and contradictory to the task.

The agent called transfer_to_human_agents with the summary parameter value claiming the case 'needs escalation' because the refund was not within policy. That contradicts the policy: an ineligible refund request should be denied, not escalated solely for an exception request, especially after the caller explicitly said they did not want a transfer.

The agent used incorrect tool parameters. In get_customer_by_phone, parameter phone_number was set to "3361232002", contradicting the caller's stated affected line "555-123-2002" and the caller said they did not know the country code. In get_customer_by_name, parameter dob was set to "1985-07-09", contradicting the caller's stated date of birth of 1980-07-09. The transfer_to_human_agents call also omitted the required summary parameter, causing a tool error. | The agent performed identity lookups that returned no match after changing caller-provided authentication details. Phone lookup used 3361232002 even though the caller provided 555-123-2002 and explicitly did not know the country code. Name/DOB lookup used dob 1985-07-09 even though the caller provided 1980-07-09. | The agent caused avoidable tool errors. The get_customer_by_phone call errored because the agent used phone_number "3361232002" even though the caller provided the affected line as 555-123-2002 and explicitly did not know the country code. The transfer_to_human_agents call also errored because the agent omitted the required summary argument.

The agent used unsupported/incorrect tool parameters. The initial get_customer_by_phone call used phone_number="5551237890" even though the caller had not provided that number and the known/correct number was 555-123-2002. Later, get_details_by_id used id="L1001", whose tool result showed phone_number 555-123-2001, contradicting the caller’s stated problem line 555-123-2002; the agent then treated that as the caller’s line status. The transfer_to_human_agents summary also incorrectly described the customer line as 555-123-2001, contradicting the caller’s line 555-123-2002. | The initial customer lookup get_customer_by_phone returned no match because the agent used unsupported/invented phone number 5551237890 before the caller had provided a phone number. The caller later provided 555-123-2002, which matched the account. | The agent caused an avoidable tool error on get_customer_by_phone by submitting the incorrect/fabricated phone number 5551237890 before the caller had provided the correct number; the lookup failed with 'Customer with phone number 5551237890 not found.'

The agent performed identity/reservation lookups with altered authentication details that returned no match: get_reservation_details used V5T3Q4 and then VA3SG4 even though the caller provided VA5SGQ, and get_user_details used rub_ruiz_5782 even though the caller provided ruben_ruiz_5782.

The agent caused an avoidable tool error by calling get_reservation_details with the wrong reservation_id, "EZ5UKW", after the caller had provided and corrected the locator as "SI5UKW". This was due to the agent's comprehension/argument error.

The transfer_to_human_agents call used summary="...Could not locate the messaging app listing..." even though the caller had just stated the installed app was “messaging.” This tool parameter contradicted the caller’s provided fact.

The errored call was return_delivered_order_items (fc_10889746471683789218). It was avoidable because the agent had already successfully processed the return for order #W5565470 in the prior return_delivered_order_items call, changing the order status to return requested; the agent then duplicated the return request, causing the predictable 'Non-delivered order cannot be returned' error.

The agent made identity lookups that returned no match using unsupported or altered authentication arguments. First, get_reservation_details was called with reservation_id ABC123, which the agent had only provided as an example, not as caller-provided information. Second, get_user_details was called with MAUEL_FERNANDEZ_9847 even though the caller spelled miguel_fernandez_9847; that altered user ID returned no match. | The agent caused avoidable tool errors. It called get_reservation_details with reservation_id "ABC123", which was only the agent's own example and had not been provided by the caller, causing 'Reservation ABC123 not found.' It also called get_user_details with "MAUEL_FERNANDEZ_9847" after the caller spelled "miguel_fernandez_9847," an avoidable transcription/comprehension error that caused 'User MAUEL_FERNANDEZ_9847 not found.'

The second exchange_delivered_order_items call used parameter order_id="#W5838674" after the prior successful exchange_delivered_order_items result had already changed that order's status to "exchange requested". Exchange calls are only valid for delivered orders, so this parameter contradicted the prior tool result/policy and the tool failed with "Non-delivered order cannot be exchanged." | The agent caused an avoidable tool error by calling exchange_delivered_order_items a second time after the first exchange_delivered_order_items call had already succeeded and changed the order status to exchange requested. The second duplicate exchange_delivered_order_items call failed with "Non-delivered order cannot be exchanged," which was avoidable with proper workflow tracking.

The agent used incorrect get_user_details user_id parameters that contradicted the caller’s clearly spelled user id, gonzalo_navarro_7340. For example, call_cx4clUv5PAaEe6gf used user_id=pemczalo_navarette_7340, which changes both the first and last name portions. The transfer_to_human_agents summary also invented an unsupported cancellation reason, saying it was due to change of plans. | The identity lookups returned no match because the agent used altered user IDs rather than the caller-provided gonzalo_navarro_7340. For example, get_user_details was called with pemczalo_navarette_7340, later pomzalo_navarette_7340/pomzalo_navaro_7340/pomzalo_navarro_7340, conflicting with the caller spelling “gonzalo_navarro_7340.” | The agent caused avoidable get_user_details errors by entering incorrect user_id arguments (e.g., pemczalo_navarette_7340 and later pomzalo_navarro_7340) after the caller had spelled the correct ID as gonzalo_navarro_7340. The errors were due to the agent's comprehension/argument entry, not caller misinformation or infrastructure.

The transfer_to_human_agents call used the summary parameter value saying the agent was "Unable to perform further APN or SIM diagnostics due to tool limitations." That was unsupported and contradicted the policy/task flow: APN and SIM diagnostics were available user-device diagnostic actions, and the caller had just agreed to check APN settings, so no tool result established such a limitation.

The agent called exchange_delivered_order_items with parameter new_item_ids=["9228757377"], but that selected camera changed the resolution from the original 24MP to 30MP. The caller explicitly required all specifications to remain the same except maximizing zoom, so this tool argument contradicted the caller's stated requirements and was not justified.

The agent performed the identity lookup find_user_id_by_email with laura.gomez@example.com, which the caller never provided; the caller then stated they did not remember their email. That unsupported/invented email lookup returned no match. | The agent caused an avoidable error in the find_user_id_by_email call by looking up laura.gomez@example.com even though the caller had not provided an email address and later stated she did not remember it. This incorrect agent-supplied argument led to the User not found tool error.

The agent made unjustified tool calls unrelated to the caller's requested coffee machine and laptop exchange: get_item_details with item_id values 7453605305 and 6534134393, which were not provided by the caller and were not in the order results, and get_product_details with product_id 6817146515 for a Desk Lamp even though the caller asked to exchange the Espresso Machine and Laptop. These parameters were unsupported by the task and prior tool results. | The agent caused avoidable tool errors by calling get_item_details with invalid, apparently fabricated item IDs 7453605305 and 6534134393, which were not provided by the caller and did not match the order item IDs shown in get_order_details. Both get_item_details calls returned 'Item not found.'

The agent searched return flights using destination HOU: search_direct_flight destination="HOU" and search_onestop_flight destination="HOU". The relevant reservation later found was OBUT9V with origin IAH and destination DEN, so a return modification had to keep the destination as IAH, not HOU. The caller only said Houston and did not justify selecting HOU.

The agent made a get_data_usage call with parameter line_id="L1001". The caller confirmed the MMS issue was on phone number 555-123-2002, and policy requires checking the line associated with the provided phone number. The prior customer lookup only listed multiple line IDs ["L1001", "L1002", "L1003"] and did not establish that L1001 corresponded to 555-123-2002, so selecting L1001 was unsupported.

The transfer_to_human_agents call used the summary parameter value stating the agent "lacks direct tools to diagnose further." This contradicts the technical support policy/toolset, which provides direct MMS troubleshooting tools such as check_apn_settings, check_wifi_calling_status, check_app_permissions, and can_send_mms.

The agent called cancel_pending_order with parameter order_id="#W5481803" after the caller had only asked to cancel the boot. Prior tool results showed #W5481803 contained both Hiking Boots and Electric Kettle, so using that order_id cancelled an additional unconfirmed item, contrary to the caller’s stated scope and the policy requirement to confirm action details.
